title: Supported etale pullback of arbitrary normalized divisor families
statement: For any two full relative Kummer-normalized divisor families C on T and Cprime on Tprime over k, their etale supported-Hom representatives commute with functorialCupPullback on every Cartesian square whose two closed immersions are effective Cartier. No separatedness, finite type, or smoothness hypothesis is needed.

source.place: lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map, Cartier-preserving geometric pullback; lem-pur-cartier-class-agreement Step 7

proof.text: Apply supported_kummer_boundary_pullback to the two normalized Ext classes with p1DecompositionTwistTransport in degree one. Constant-unit normalization and uniqueness identify its source exchange with functorialCupExchange. Apply Ext.hom, expand Ext.comp_hom, Ext.mk₀_hom and Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom, and cancel the degree-zero source exchange. The two realization fields identify the endpoints. The full relative boundary fixes the section and sign; empty Cartier divisors are included.

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedDivisorFamily_pullback (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {D T D' T' : Scheme.{u}} (a : T ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    (a' : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    (C : P.DivisorEtaleClasses T) (C' : P.DivisorEtaleClasses T')
    (hC : P.DivisorEtaleNormalized T a C)
    (hC' : P.DivisorEtaleNormalized T' a' C')
    (i : D ⟶ T) (i' : D' ⟶ T') [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (h : T' ⟶ T) (w : D' ⟶ D) (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare w i' i h)
    (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible) (hI' : i'.ker.IsInvertible) :
    P.functorialCupPullback false i i' h w sq a 2 1 (C.homClassOf i hI) =
      C'.homClassOf i' hI'
